title: feat(site): animate repository DNA across homepage
context: What changed: added initParticleDna, clamp, range, makeDotTexture, seeded, sampleThoughtPulse, addPointerScatter, makeParticleField; new dep(s): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.185.0/build/three.module.min.js; 1 new file(s).
